figurative_meaning_en: A love-hate relationship or ambivalent bond
example_sentences_in_bangla: তাদের দাঁতে জিভে সম্পর্ক, কখনো সাহায্য করে কখনো কামড়ায়।
প্রতিবেশীদের মধ্যে দাঁতে জিভে সম্পর্ক বিদ্যমান।
example_sentences_in_english: They have a teeth-and-tongue relationship, helping each other one moment and clashing the next.
There's a teeth-and-tongue bond between the neighbors.
history: The idiom originates from the anatomical proximity of teeth and tongue in the mouth; teeth can accidentally bite the tongue, causing pain, yet the tongue aids in relieving tooth discomfort by movement or saliva.
note: This idiom highlights the duality in close relationships, common in Bengali oral traditions.
